name: Scattered Divine
source: In this Adult Visual Novel, you play as one of the greatest warriors in existence. Your strength is unparalleled, your power is immense, and your wit is lacking. With the mere clap of your hands, you can summon clones of yourself into battle. The goal is to continue a 300-year-old odyssey to find the Scattered Divine and assemble the Elf Goddess to be granted your wish. Of course, there are obstacles, accidents, and plenty of delightful women along the way. Will you complete your family's legacy or succumb to task at hand?​
